topic: The Malthusian Trap — and How Humanity Escaped It
query: Malthusian trap Malthus population subsistence industrial revolution demographic transition agricultural productivity escape
guidance: Explain the trap itself — why Malthus's logic was sound and why it described all of human history up to ~1800. Then focus on the escape: industrial revolution, demographic transition, agricultural productivity. Why the escape happened when and where it did is still debated — include that uncertainty.
